scope: Eight saved settings on two pages; optional contact-only regular grass; initial contextual HM-user fallback.
limitations: Experimental builds; the full enhancement goal is incomplete.
Roaming only applies to regular grass with Few/Some/Many; Off restores native encounters; water/caves/special contexts remain native.
Native legendary roamers are not rendered as visible sprites yet; their hidden grass step branch is suppressed while Roaming only applies.

Native HM badge/story scripts are retained byte-identically. Full use, animation, badge rejection, cancellation and transitions remain unverified in the emulator; Fly/Flash menu integration remains pending.
Runs use isolated copies of project-created saves, including the prior HG-derived SS fixture. No user save was supplied and general interchangeability is not established.
No developer RAM fixtures or Pokemon/HP/badge/move/item edits were used in these milestone-12 runs.

Normal control runs restore option 0 and show no blocked grass checks; they are not evidence of a native random battle because one reached no battle and the other reached a visible contact battle. Native fallback is verified by compiled ARM tests.
Bounded Route 29 runs do not prove all-map/all-species/capacity/long-session acceptance.
